title: Kidnapped by Toro Calican
subtitle: The Journey of Grogu
description: On the run with the Mandalorian, Grogu finds himself on Tatooine, and no one quite knows just how valuable he really is. That is until Toro Calican realizes his worth and kidnaps him! It takes every ounce of skill for the Mandalorian to track Grogu across the dune seas and get his young charge back from the inexperienced Toro.
